answer: Re-run a sample of every answer on a second node and compare. When the two diverge past tolerance, slash both copies and revoke credit on a single upheld challenge, with no second appeal. Bar any identity from auditing an account it recruited, because a panel that clears its own recruits is hollow. The nectar here is graded pay, and it arrives only when the second node agrees. A farm can still reach a modest zenith on cheap tasks, but it pays twice for every answer.
